svg.aria-label: Tools. Running in my lab: Splunk, CrowdSec, Pi-hole, Unbound, ufw, Debian, Ubuntu, Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale. Explored: Wazuh, Sysmon, TheHive, Shuffle SOAR, VirusTotal API. Learning: Python, MITRE ATT&CK. Next: AWS IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC design, Terraform, Docker.
